column2: This is to certify that the undersigned is/are the owner(s) of the land described in the annexed plat and that I/we have caused the land to be surveyed and subdivided as indicated thereon for the uses and purposes set forth herein. I/we also certify to the best of my/our knowledge that all recorded and unrecorded easements, restrictions, reservations or covenants have been indicated on the annexed plat. I/we hereby acknowledge and adopt the same as my/our act this ____________________ day of ____________________, 20_____.
